assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, mouse liver (S9.p1; Methods RNA-seq paragraph, line 111-115 of paper.md)
primary_estimand: Effect of the gp130 Y814 inhibitor R159 vs vehicle on liver gene expression in aged (16-month) male C57BL/6 mice on high-fat diet (Fig. 3e,f). Exercise is not an intervention in this paper: voluntary wheel running is measured only as a behavioural outcome (Fig. legend line 63).
planned_contrasts: HFD-R159 vs HFD-Veh in liver (Fig. 3e,f; no DEG count reported, heat map of inflammation/fibrosis genes only)
exercise_contrast: none: no exercise vs sedentary arm exists; wheel running is an outcome, not a factor

paper_threshold.source_locator: Methods RNA-seq paragraph: fold change > 1.5 and p-value < 0.05

paper_results: Veh up vs R159: Ccl2, Tlr5, Col1a1, Ctsk, Mmp2, Pdgfc, Apob, Lpl, Sele, Vcam1; no DEG total given
